EXECUTIVE ORDER 11626
T h e H onorable D ean Acheson
As a special mark o f respect to the memory o f the H onorable Dean 
Acheson, form er Secretary o f State, it is hereby ordered, pursuant to the 
provisions o f Section 4 o f Proclam ation 3044 o f M arch 1, 1954, as 
amended, that until interment the flag o f the U nited States shall be flow n 
at half-staff on all buildings, grounds and naval vessels o f the Federal 
Government in the District o f Colum bia and throughout the U nited 
States and its Territories and possessions. I also direct that the flag shall 
be flow n at half-staff for the same length o f time at all U nited States 
embassies, legations, consular offices, and other facilities abroad, includ­
ing all military facilities and naval vessels and stations.
